title: Work
description: Mechanical energy transfer associated with a force acting through displacement of its point of application. Along a trajectory, infinitesimal work is the scalar product of force and displacement, integrated over the motion.

relations.note: Parameterizing the trajectory converts work to an ordinary definite integral.
The Euclidean dot product selects the component of force along the displacement.
Mechanical work is one contribution to energy transfer across a thermodynamic system boundary.
